entries.en: Added agent view (Research Preview): a single list of every Claude Code session — running, blocked on you, or done. Run `claude agents` to get started. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view
entries.zh: 添加了代理视图（研究预览）：每个 Claude Code 会话的单个列表 - 正在运行、被阻止或已完成。运行“claude Agents”即可开始。请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view

entries.en: Added `/goal` command: set a completion condition and Claude keeps working across turns until it's met. Works in interactive, `-p`, and Remote Control. Shows live elapsed/turns/tokens as an overlay panel
entries.zh: 添加了`/goal`命令：设置完成条件，克劳德继续轮流工作，直到满足为止。适用于交互式、`-p`和远程控制。将实时经过/回合/令牌显示为覆盖面板

entries.en: Added `/scroll-speed` command to tune mouse wheel scroll speed with a live preview
entries.zh: 添加了`/scroll-speed`命令以通过实时预览调整鼠标滚轮滚动速度

entries.en: Added `claude plugin details <name>` to show a plugin's component inventory and projected per-session token cost
entries.zh: 添加了“claude 插件详细信息 <name>”，以显示插件的组件库存和预计的每个会话令牌成本

entries.en: Added transcript view navigation: `?` for keyboard shortcuts, `{`/`}` to jump between user prompts, `v` to toggle shortcut panel
entries.zh: 添加了文字记录视图导航：`?`用于键盘快捷键，“{`/`}”用于在用户提示之间跳转，`v`用于切换快捷面板

entries.en: Added hook `args: string[]` field (exec form) that spawns the command directly without a shell, so path placeholders never need quoting
entries.zh: 添加了钩子 `args: string[]` 字段（exec 形式），无需 shell 即可直接生成命令，因此路径占位符永远不需要引用

entries.en: Added hook `continueOnBlock` config option for `PostToolUse` — set to `true` to feed the hook's rejection reason back to Claude and continue the turn
entries.zh: 为`PostToolUse`添加了钩子`continueOnBlock`配置选项 - 设置为`true`以将钩子的拒绝原因反馈给 Claude 并继续回合

entries.en: MCP stdio servers now receive `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` in their environment, matching hooks. Plugin configs can reference `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` in commands
entries.zh: MCP stdio 服务器现在会在环境变量中收到 `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`，与 hook 保持一致。插件配置的命令中可以引用 `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}`

entries.en: API requests from subagents now carry `x-claude-code-agent-id` / `x-claude-code-parent-agent-id` headers, and `claude_code.llm_request` OTEL spans include `agent_id` / `parent_agent_id` attributes
entries.zh: 来自子代理的 API 请求现在携带 `x-claude-code-agent-id` / `x-claude-code-parent-agent-id` 标头，并且 `claude_code.llm_request` OTEL 跨度包含 `agent_id` / `parent_agent_id` 属性

entries.en: [VSCode] Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T to reopen the most recently closed session tab, configurable via `claudeCode.enableReopenClosedSessionShortcut`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 按 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T 可重新打开最近关闭的会话标签页，可通过 `claudeCode.enableReopenClosedSessionShortcut` 配置

entries.en: Compaction prompt now asks the model to preserve sensitive user instructions
entries.zh: 压缩提示现在要求模型保留敏感的用户指令

entries.en: `/mcp` Reconnect now picks up `.mcp.json` edits without a restart, and shows the HTTP status and URL when reconnecting fails
entries.zh: `/mcp` 的 Reconnect 现在无需重启即可读取 `.mcp.json` 的修改；重连失败时会显示 HTTP 状态和 URL

entries.en: `/context all` per-skill token estimates now account for the model's tokenizer and show rounded values
entries.zh: `/context all` 中每个 skill 的 token 估算现在会考虑模型的分词器，并显示取整后的数值

entries.en: `claude plugin install <name>@<marketplace>` now auto-refreshes the marketplace and retries before reporting a plugin as not found
entries.zh: `claude plugin install <name>@<marketplace>` 现在会先自动刷新市场并重试，然后才报告插件未找到

entries.en: `/plugin` installed-plugin details now show hook event names and MCP server names cleanly
entries.zh: `/plugin` 中已安装插件的详情现在会清晰显示 hook 事件名称和 MCP 服务器名称

entries.en: `/context` now shows the providing plugin's name for plugin-sourced skills
entries.zh: 对于插件提供的 skill，`/context` 现在会显示提供该插件的名称

entries.en: Remote MCP server reconnect retry on transient failures is now enabled for all users
entries.zh: 远程 MCP 服务器遇到临时故障时的重连重试，现已对所有用户开启

entries.en: Remote Control, `/schedule`, claude.ai MCP connectors, and notification preferences are now disabled when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `apiKeyHelper` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` is set, even if a Claude.ai login also exists. Unset the API key to use these features
entries.zh: 设置了 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`、`apiKeyHelper` 或 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` 后，Remote Control、`/schedule`、claude.ai MCP 连接器和通知偏好现已禁用，即使同时存在 Claude.ai 登录。取消设置 API 密钥即可使用这些功能

entries.en: Fixed a deadlock where expired credentials and the `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` policy setting blocked `claude auth login`/`logout`/`status` with no way to recover
entries.zh: 修复了过期凭据和`forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`策略设置阻止`claude auth login`/`logout`/`status`且无法恢复的死锁

entries.en: Fixed `autoAllowBashIfSandboxed` not auto-approving commands with shell expansions like `$VAR` and `$(cmd)`
entries.zh: 修复了`autoAllowBashIfSandboxed`不自动批准带有`$VAR`和`$(cmd)`等 shell 扩展的命令

entries.en: Fixed a bug where a hook writing to the terminal could corrupt an on-screen interactive prompt; hooks now run without terminal access
entries.zh: 修复了写入终端的钩子可能会破坏屏幕上的交互式提示的错误；挂钩现在无需终端访问即可运行

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth when an HTTP/SSE MCP server streams non-protocol data — response bodies now capped at 16 MB per SSE frame
entries.zh: 修复 HTTP/SSE MCP 服务器流式输出非协议数据时内存无限增长的问题；现在每个 SSE 帧的响应体上限为 16 MB

entries.en: Fixed `Skill(name *)` permission rules — the wildcard form now works as a prefix match, matching `Bash(ls *)` behavior
entries.zh: 修复了 `Skill(name *)` 权限规则 - 通配符形式现在用作前缀匹配，匹配 `Bash(ls *)` 行为

entries.en: Fixed settings hot-reload not detecting edits to symlinked `~/.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了设置热重载未检测到对符号链接`~/.claude/settings.json`的编辑

entries.en: Fixed plugin details failing to load when the marketplace key differs from the manifest name
entries.zh: 修复了当市场密钥与清单名称不同时无法加载插件详细信息的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` picker "Default" row not reflecting `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`/`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` overrides
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`选择器“默认”行不反映`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`/`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`覆盖的问题

entries.en: Fixed spurious "stream idle timeout" 5 minutes after a response completed, caused by the watchdog timer not being cleared on stream cancellation
entries.zh: 修复了响应完成后 5 分钟出现虚假“流空闲超时”的问题，该超时是由于在流取消时未清除看门狗计时器而导致的

entries.en: Fixed silent `exit 1` when 10+ MCP servers are configured and the cache directory is unwritable — the error message now includes the underlying cause
entries.zh: 修复了配置超过 10 个 MCP 服务器且缓存目录不可写时出现静默`exit 1`的问题 — 错误消息现在包含根本原因

entries.en: Fixed a typing cursor blinking on tab names, list pointers, and select rows in dialogs
entries.zh: 修复了打字光标在选项卡名称、列表指针和对话框中选择行上闪烁的问题

entries.en: Fixed transcript view letter shortcuts not working after mouse click
entries.zh: 修复鼠标点击后，转录视图的字母快捷键失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash-mode up-arrow history repeating the first entry and clobbering the in-progress draft
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 模式向上箭头历史记录重复第一个条目并破坏正在进行的草稿的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasting or dropping multiple images only inserting the last one
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴或删除多个图像时仅插入最后一张图像的问题

entries.en: Fixed hyperlinks using unreadable dark navy on dark themes — they now adapt to the active theme
entries.zh: 修复了在深色主题上使用不可读的深色海军蓝的超链接 - 它们现在适应活动主题

entries.en: Fixed model picker showing a redundant "Current model" row for third-party users whose model is set to the `opus` alias
entries.zh: 修复了模型选择器为模型设置为`opus`别名的第三方用户显示冗余“当前模型”行的问题

entries.en: Fixed legacy Opus picker entry on PAYG 3P providers resolving to the same model as the default entry
entries.zh: 修复了 PAYG 3P 提供商上的旧版 Opus 选择器条目解析为与默认条目相同的模型

entries.en: Fixed mouse wheel scrolling speed in Cursor and VS Code 1.92–1.104; the trackpad now scrolls at a steady rate and the mouse wheel keeps ~3 lines per notch
entries.zh: 修复了光标和 VS Code 1.92–1.104 中的鼠标滚轮滚动速度；触控板现在以稳定的速度滚动，鼠标滚轮每格保持约 3 行

entries.en: Fixed scroll behavior in Windows Terminal and VS Code when attached to background sessions
entries.zh: 修复了附加到后台会话时 Windows 终端和 VS Code 中的滚动行为

entries.en: Fixed MCP resources from disconnected servers lingering in `@server:` autocomplete
entries.zh: 修复了来自断开连接的服务器的 MCP 资源在`@server:`自动完成中徘徊的问题

entries.en: Fixed two-file diff snippets over-reporting the number of truncated lines by one
entries.zh: 修复双文件差异片段对被截断行数多报了一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Grep results not relativizing Windows drive-letter paths and count mode reporting wrong totals for single-file paths
entries.zh: 修复了 Grep 结果未相对化 Windows 驱动器盘符路径和计数模式报告单文件路径总数错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed border-embedded text overflowing on CJK/emoji due to visual cell width miscalculation
entries.zh: 修复了由于视觉单元宽度计算错误导致的边框嵌入文本在 CJK/emoji 上溢出的问题

entries.en: Fixed fuzzy-match highlighting splitting emoji and astral-plane characters mid-pair
entries.zh: 修复了模糊匹配突出显示分割表情符号和星体平面字符中间对的问题

entries.en: Fixed skill argument names containing regex metacharacters breaking argument substitution
entries.zh: 修复了包含正则表达式元字符的技能参数名称，破坏了参数替换

entries.en: Fixed ProgressBar rendering a full block for an almost-full fractional cell
entries.zh: 修复了 ProgressBar 为几乎满的分数单元格呈现完整块的问题

entries.en: Fixed task polling and `fs.watch` being resurrected when the last subscriber leaves while a fetch is in flight
entries.zh: 修复最后一个订阅者离开而某次获取仍在进行时，任务轮询和 `fs.watch` 被重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin dependency resolution leaving a stale count when the manifest name differs from the source identifier
entries.zh: 修复了当清单名称与源标识符不同时插件依赖项解析留下陈旧计数的问题

entries.en: Fixed Insights Time-of-Day chart skewing when a session has an unparseable timestamp
entries.zh: 修复了当会话具有无法解析的时间戳时 Insights 时间图表倾斜的问题

entries.en: Fixed keybindings using only the cmd/super/win modifier being flagged as unparseable
entries.zh: 修复了仅使用 cmd/super/win 修饰符的键绑定被标记为不可解析的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude_code.active_time.total` OpenTelemetry metric not being emitted in `--print` mode
entries.zh: 修复了在`--print`模式下未发出`claude_code.active_time.total` OpenTelemetry 指标的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin update` not preserving cross-plugin symlinks inside a marketplace
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件更新”不保留市场内跨插件符号链接的问题
